observed_failure_history.scope: Expanded owned scientific tests before rights normalization

owned_harness_history: The initial tripwire harness stopped before collecting tests because pytest writes its own bookkeeping keys. Those two exact pytest keys now use an in-memory overlay; no actual environment mutation or product permission was added.

The next harness attempt could not import the explicitly owned repository test helper because script execution places review_pack first on sys.path. The exact ROOT5 directory is now added for owned fixture imports, matching python -m pytest behavior.
remaining_milestone_gates: Native SQL and complete migration acceptance
Final package/source identity association and installed wheel
Whole mandatory final-SHA CI and publication review
Separately accepted source qualifications, custody and owner protocol intent before any real evaluation

resolved_findings.issue: Undeclared qualified source profiles could enter a registered protocol
resolved_findings.resolution: The initial immutable source manifest fixes profile and purpose identities. Only independently qualified new vintages within that exact profile scope can enter forecast/catalogue/outcome records.

resolved_findings.issue: Point adapters accepted nonnumeric or numerically duplicated PMF support
resolved_findings.resolution: Canonical integer support and Decimal mean reconciliation reject malformed support before retention. Pure point forecasts keep an empty PMF.

resolved_findings.issue: Denied capabilities escaped the ledger error boundary as IngestionError
resolved_findings.resolution: Known rights failures unwind before a fixed OperationError; the owned denial reaches no engine and has no retained exception cause/context.

resolved_findings.issue: Resealed scorecards could contradict their cohort denominator
resolved_findings.resolution: Cross-field validation binds counts, unique forecast/label identities and complete optional diagnostics.

sql_review_scope: The integrity helper was inspected read-only, including exact zero-argument function identities. Native SQL guard/transaction/deep-lineage acceptance and migration-source custody are separate independent reviews; no native database clearance is inferred here.
verified_invariants: The existing full forecast retains original mean, PMF, components, minutes, model, rules, code, sources and all stored cutoffs; scoring does not mutate it.
Point-only inputs receive point metrics while PMF, components, minutes, starts and60-minute diagnostics remain explicitly unavailable. Mixed cohorts do not select only available rows.
All catalogue players and all predeclared model cells must join exactly. Missing, duplicate, changed model/code/rules, catalogue and labels fail before the metric kernel.
Prospective protocols register before the first exact deadline and score a strictly later holdout; post-origin recovery remains descriptive and never gains a newly claimed confirmatory split.
Label values and complete populations require qualification beyond source rights. Every retained upstream source must independently permit immutable retention and evaluation.
An explicit complete label vintage is required; mixed revision, source or finalization within a Gameweek rejects. Complete correction vintages preserve original forecast hashes.
Stage12 point, probability and distribution outputs agree directly on owned fixtures, with the inherited metric source bytes unchanged.
No statistical independence of player rows is claimed, clustered inference is not computed, and promotion remains forbidden.
